newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan coffee exports 1.25 million bags-FEBEC.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan coffee exports 1.25 million bags-FEBEC.

text.p: Brazil exported 1.25 million 60-kg bags of coffee, ground and in beans, in January, below a downwardly revised December figure of 1.52 million bags, the Brazilian Federation of Coffee Exporters (FEBEC) said.
The January total is double the 589,340 bags exported in the same month in 1996 when exports were limited due to a frost the previous year, Febec said.
Export receipts in January were $160.14 million compared with $75.20 million in the same month last year.
Of the total shipped, 1.22 million bags were of arabica coffee while conillon accounted for just 21,600 bags.
The port of Santos continued to be the main shipping point, handling 994,200 bags, followed by Vitoria with 217,900 bags and Rio de Janeiro with 31,000 bags.
